Nora Li: Kickoff for benchmark launch content + webinar. Outcome: a compact unit-econ story (tokens->$) + latency tradeoffs, 3 visuals, and inbound routing. Keep messaging testable.

Diego Vega: My visual picks: (1) $/1M tokens — baseline vs optimized (side-by-side bars), (2) p95 latency comparison: hosted / dedicated / private (small multiples), (3) SLO vs cost curve annotated with fallback points.

Harper Singh: For chart 1 show two bars per bucket: no-optimization and optimized (batching+quant). Buckets: small/medium/large/xlarge. Add tiny calc example under the chart.

Renee Cho: Messaging tracks: Startup CTA = "Run a 5-min micro-benchmark: see your tokens->$". Enterprise CTA = "Schedule capacity planning: predictable latency & costs". Map clicks to different nurture flows.

Diego Vega: Chart copy drafts:
- Headline: Real spend per 1M tokens across model sizes
  Takeaway: Applied optimizations reduce cost by multipleX in many workloads.
- Headline: Tail latency by deployment (p95)
  Takeaway: Dedicated narrows tails; hosted is easiest to scale.
- Headline: SLO vs spend with fallbacks
  Takeaway: Graceful fallbacks keep SLOs while capping cost during spikes.

Harper Singh: Example calc snippet: `1M tokens = 2000 calls * 500 tokens avg -> baseline $120 -> optimized ~$40` (illustrative). Include assumptions footnote.

Renee Cho: Routing rules: micro-bench runner + contact -> SDR warm + deployment tag; runner anonymous -> results email + 2-email nurture; enterprise CTA -> AE queue with calendar booking; webinar only -> 3-email drip + bench invite. Track run->demo conversions.

bench-bot: Playbook saved: https://internal.redwood/bench/econ-launch-playbook. Attached sample CSV and chart spec. :robot_face:

Nora Li: Owners: Diego = final chart copy + design brief (Tue), Harper = sample CSV + calc examples (Tue), Renee = CTA copy + routing matrix + tracking spec (Wed). I'll draft 90s demo script once numbers are in. Anything else?

Diego Vega: Can we include a 1-line on fallback compatibility constraints (which model variants are safe for fallbacks)? Add that to the notes for Samira engineering check.

Nora Li: Good call. Add an engineering check item. Closing thread, will convert to tickets. :thumbsup:
